description: This file contains the PHP class implementation for the SubTotal extension in the OpenCart admin system. It defines the SubTotal controller, including methods for rendering the subtotal configuration page and saving configuration settings.

classes.name: SubTotal
classes.description: Controller class for managing the subtotal extension in the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the subtotal extension configuration page in the admin panel.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the subtotal extension settings via AJAX request.
